usage: deskops show pill [-h] [--root ROOT] [--format {text,json}] doc_id

positional arguments:
  doc_id                Pill selector. Selectors accept an exact id, filename,
                        stem, or unique slug fragment where supported.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --format {text,json}  Output format.
